out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: OBSERVED INTERIOR OF ICE MACHINE IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PLEASE THOROUGHLY CLEAN AND SANITIZE THE INTERIOR OF THE ICE MACHINE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Pasteurized foods used; prohibited foods not offered

violations.title: Raw/Undercooked Animal Foods Prohibited in HSP
violations.observation: The following raw or partially cooked meat, fish, shell eggs, and/or molluscan shellfish offered for sale or service in a facility that serves a highly susceptible population: OBSERVED SMOKED SALMON AT THE ESTABLISHMENT (PACKAGING DOES NOT STATE THAT IT IS READY TO EAT).
violations.corrective_action: In a food service establishment that serves a highly susceptible population, foods may not be served or offered for sale in a ready-to-eat form if the food is a partially cooked animal food such as lightly cooked fish, rare meat, soft cooked eggs, or meringue. PIC AGREED TO DISCONTINUE SERVING SMOKED SALMON IN THE ESTABLISHMENT. PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS IF YOU HAVE ANY QUESTIONS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly: OBSERVED THE MAIN DISHWASHING MACHINE NOT SANITIZING (0PPM) AND THE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISHWASHING MACHINE MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 158F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. A REPAIR TECHNICIAN CAME DURING THE INSPECTION TO REPAIR BOTH DISHWASHING MACHINES. OBSERVED THE MAIN DISHWASHING MACHINE AT 150PPM DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE STAFF UNDERSTAND HOW TO TEST THE DISHWASHING MACHINES AND THAT THEY SHOULD NOT BE USED IF THEY ARE NOT SANITIZING PROPERLY. HUNTERS WOODS AT TRAILS EDGE (Inspection Date: 09/03/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. PLEASE ENSURE MORE STAFF RECEIVE CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATION BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: OBSERVED FRUIT FLIES (APPROXIMATELY 10) IN THE MEMORY CARE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE PROVIDE EHS WITH PEST CONTROL INVOICE BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION ANC CONTINUE TO WORK ON ELIMINATING THE FRUIT FLY ISSUE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly: OBSERVED THE MAIN DISHWASHING MACHINE NOT DELIVERING ANY SANITIZER (0PPM) AND THE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISHWASHING MACHINE IN THE MEMORY CARE KITCHEN MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 126.5F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. THREE-VAT SINK WAS SET UP DURING INSPECTION; PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL DISHWARE/UTENSILS SHOULD BE SANITIZED IN THE THREE-VAT SINK UNTIL BOTH ARE REPAIRED. PLEASE ENSURE A PERMANENT SOLUTION FOR BOTH DISHWASHING MACHINES IS DETERMINED BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION TO PREVENT FURTHER ENFORCEMENT ACTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the BLEACH sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit.

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PLEASE ENUSRE A HIGH TEMPERATURE THERMOMETER DISC OR TEST STRIPS ARE OBTAINED BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: Observed no written cleaning procedures for vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH FAIRFAX COUNTY’S VOMIT AND DIARRHEA CLEAN UP PROCEDURES IN ENGLISH AND SPANISH.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed PIC fail to wash hands at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. WASH HANDS FREQUENTLY, AFTER CHANGING TASKS, ENGAGING IN FOOD PREPARATION, AFTER HANDLING CHEMICALS, ETC. . PIC WASHED HANDS DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the hand sink at the pizza station.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. STAFF MEMBER PLACED A ROLL OF PAPER TOWELS AT THIS HAND SINK. ALL HAND SINKS MUST HAVE PAPER TOWELS TO FACILITATE PROPER HANDWASHING.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: In the dinning room at the server station, a wet towel bucket was observed in the basin of a handsink.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. ALL HANDSINK MUST BE UNBLOCKED AND FULLY ACCESSIBLE.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Multiple hand washing signs were observed missing throughout the facility where food preparation occurs
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH 4 HAND WASHING SIGNS. POST A SIGN AT EACH HAND SINK.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The main, chemical dish machine, located in the main kitchen, was observed at 0ppm chlorine concentration. The small, high temperature dish machine, located in memory care, was observed at 105f.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO USE THE DISH MACHINES TO WASH AND RINSE. ALL SANITIZING MUST OCCUR IN THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. PIC AND STAFF MEMBERS SET UP THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK TO SANITIZE WITH QUATERNARY AMMONIUM.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR upright Hot Box; mashed potatoes (111f), ratatouille (108f), rice (96f); 2) in the expo window under a heat lamp; roasted carrots (109f); 3) on the stove; unsalted butter (100f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED THE UNSALTED BUTTER. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMBERS TO REHEAT THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS TO 165f. HUNTERS WOODS AT TRAILS EDGE (Inspection Date: 01/16/2026) Page 2 of 5

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR upright in memory care; milk (46f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE MILK.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: using the the top of the prep top cooler to cool cut melon to 41f from ambient temperature
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. COOL FOOD TO 41f FROM AMBIENT TEMPERATURE USING THE WALK-IN COOLER BEFORE PLACING THEM IN THE PREP TOP COOLER.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Observed an insect control bug light mounted above a reach in cooler in a prep area. Observed an insect control bug light mounted above a hand sink in another prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. MOVE BUG LIGHTS AWAY FROM FOOD PREP AREAS TO AVOID AN INSECT PARTICLES FROM FALLING INTO FOOD OR FOOD-RELATED ITEMS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food was observed being stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE ALL FOOD TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed a measuring cup being stored in a bulk dry good bin with the handle laying in the ingredient
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. ENSURE THE HANDLE OF THE MEASURING CUP OR SCOOP DOES NOT TOUCH THE FOOD. STORE SCOOP ON THE OUTSIDE, HANGING, OR IN THE FOOD WITH THE HANDLE STICKING UPWARDS.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed several pots being stored on a shelf at the end of the cook line that have not been inverted
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. INVERT POTS AND PANS TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Fixed Equipment, Properly Spaced and Sealed
violations.observation: Observed inconsistent caulking along the space adjoining the wall and metal dish/sink surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment that is fixed because it is not easily movable shall be installed so that it is: 1) spaced to allow access for cleaning along the sides, behind, and above the equipment, 2) spaced from adjoining equipment, walls, and ceilings a distance of not more than 1 millimeter or one thirty-second inch, and 3) sealed to adjoining equipment or walls if the equipment is exposed to spillage or seepage. RE-CAULK/ RE-SEAL THESE AREAS OF THE DISH AREA.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): to elevate food off of the floor in the walk-in freezer
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. REPLACE MILK CRATES WITH NSF APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) main chemical dish machine in the kitchen; 2) small high temperature dish machine in memory care; 3) 1DR upright hot box
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. DISCONTINUE USING THE DISH MACHINES FOR SANITIZING. DISH MACHINES MAY BE USE TO WASH AND RINSE. DISCONTINUE USING THE HOT BOX UNTIL IT IS FUNCTIONING PROPERLY.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: aluminum foil liners along the cook line
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. REMOVE ALUMINUM FOIL TO FACILITATE ROUTINE CLEANING.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: Observed no quaternary ammonia test kit in the facility
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. PURCHASE A QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KIT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: interior of hood system, microwave, and coolers
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. MORE FREQUENT AND THOROUGH CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The basin of the hand sink next to the office was observed draining slowly
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. ENSURE BASIN DRAINS PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Both men and women employee bathrooms in the basement were observed without self-closing doors.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. INSTALL A SELF-CLOSING DOOR MECHANISM.

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: An uncovered trash receptacle was observed in the women’s employee bathroom in the basement.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. PLACE A COVERED TRASH RECEPTACLE IN THIS BATHROOM.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed missing ceiling tiles and duct tape being used around the dish area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. REPLACE CEILING TILES. REPAIR AREA THAT THE DUCT TAPE IS COVERING.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the walls and ceiling tiles in the dish area in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. MORE FREQUENT AND THOROUGH CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed wet mop heads being stored directly in the mop bucket.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. HANG OR INVERT MOPS TO ALLOW MOP HEADS TO AIR DRY.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lockers, In Designated Room/Area
violations.observation: Observed personal belongings being hung on dry storage shelving throughout the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate lockers and personal storage facilities to prevent the potential contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, linens, or single-service items. INSTALL MORE COAT HOOKS TO ALLOW FOR PERSONAL BELONGINGS TO BE HUNG UP TO PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION. HUNTERS WOODS AT TRAILS EDGE (Inspection Date: 01/16/2026) Page 3 of 5

violations.title: Ventilation System Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed dirty filters in the hood system at the cook line
violations.corrective_action: Clean intake and exhaust air ducts at regularly intervals to prevent them from becoming sources of contamination. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED. HUNTERS WOODS AT TRAILS EDGE (Inspection Date: 01/16/2026) Page 4 of 5
